name: metro-muted-pixel-v1
prompt: Strict coarse 16-bit pixel art for a worn Shanghai metro survival game. Orthographic game sprite, crisp square pixel clusters, transparent background, no antialiasing, no text or watermark. Muted slate-purple outlines, dusty mauve, faded teal, cream, grey and ochre. Restrained shading, readable silhouette, 12-18 colors per subject. Consistent proportions, lighting from upper left and scale across frames.
